page.running_head: Lib. 7. De communi scriptur. tractat. ratione.

main_text.l: Prima, vt de cuiusq; parte, siue quæstione, cla-
rissima Mosis testimonia de ea re scrutentur, vt om-
exempla, in historijs, per speciales applicationes, in
Similium collatio, est præter eam quæ dicta est,
ad sententias, & phrases similes, ex similibus illu-
Dissimilium, est earum quæ nisi conciliarentur,
serie,quædam, vel analogiæ scripturæ, vel particula-
ribus testimonijs quæ perspicua sunt, repugnare vi-
dentur :tum eis allatis, sensus repugnantiæ relin-
modo cum reliquis omnibus scripturis, sed qui sit
genuinus,hoc est, qui ex similiū collatione, præsen-
tibus, circumstantijs omnibus, totæ denique ana-
lysi, tum analogiæ, tum crypticæ, tum ad materiam
logicæ, tum ad orationem, dialecticæ, & theoricæ,

page.notes: Marginal fragments on the left edge belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Some words in the scan are blurred; "sententiæ" and "consentiat" read with some doubt. Catchword "Secundum" is printed in italic at the foot right.
